segments.note: Cloud computing rented to companies — up 30%, and its operating profit more than doubled to $2.1B.

takeaways.text: Google Cloud revenue jumped 30% to $12.0B, and its operating profit more than doubled to $2.1B — the cloud has become a real second engine, not just a growth story.
takeaways.title: Cloud is compounding

takeaways.text: Search & other revenue rose 13% to $54.0B and YouTube ads grew 14% to $10.5B — the advertising core still supplies the great bulk of Alphabet's money.
takeaways.title: Search still pays for everything

takeaways.text: Net income rose 28% to $26.5B — about 28 cents of every revenue dollar — even after spending $14.3B in the quarter on property and equipment, mostly data centers.
takeaways.title: Profit kept 28 cents per dollar

verdict: Alphabet grew revenue 12% to $96.5B as Search rose 13% and Google Cloud jumped 30% — and it kept $26.5B as profit, with Cloud's profit more than doubling.
